result.brief: Sekai2 是一个大规模真实世界视频数据集，提供相机轨迹、分层时序标注与全景回访序列，面向长时程视频生成、相机可控合成与交互式世界模型预训练。
result.reason: Sekai2 provides 2,826 hours of video with camera trajectories, temporally grounded captions, and panoramic revisit sequences explicitly for long-horizon video generation and interactive world-model pre-training.
